idea-plugin.name: Personal Data Map
idea-plugin.description:
Reads a migration, Prisma schema, Django model or TypeORM entity and marks every column a subject access request has to reach - with the GDPR article each finding hangs on. 13 rules, line numbers, no account.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Personal Data Map: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 13 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/personal-data-map-dsar-audit (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/personal-data-map-dsar-audit

action.text: Personal Data Map: Check This File
action.description: Run Personal Data Map on the file in the editor
